name: @fortemate/dicechess-tv

scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:core && npm run coverage:native
scripts.coverage:native: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --import ./native/test/hooks.mjs --enable-source-maps --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude='native/test/**' --test-coverage-exclude='native/src/pieces/**' --test-coverage-exclude='native/src/cueFiles.ts' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/native.lcov native/test/*.test.tsx native/test/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src native test scripts site *.json *.md docs/*.md .github/**/*.yml .github/**/*.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src native test scripts site *.json *.md docs/*.md .github/**/*.yml .github/**/*.yaml

description: Dice Chess for Amazon Fire TV. The application is in native/; this package holds the shared pure core it runs on and the piece artwork.
